question: Find Hodgkin Lymphoma trials with median follow‑up and show months by arm.

gemini.answer: This SQL query retrieves the NCT ID, author, year, PubMed ID, and follow-up durations (overall, treatment arm, and control arm in months) for all clinical trials related to Hodgkin Lymphoma.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\", \"follow_up_duration_rx_months\", \"follow_up_duration_control_months\" FROM public.\"clinical_trials\" WHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%Hodgkin%'",
  "answer": "This SQL query retrieves the NCT ID, author, year, PubMed ID, and follow-up durations (overall, treatment arm, and control arm in months) for all clinical trials related to Hodgkin Lymphoma.",
```
